data.name: Atul
data.gender_notes: Atul is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + tul, 'to weigh, compare' — 'incomparable'. Its root is Sanskrit a + tul. A classical Sanskrit term for the incomparable. Atul is a Sanskrit name meaning “Incomparable; matchless; unequalled”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Atul expresses “Incomparable; matchless; unequalled”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + tul, 'to weigh, compare' — 'incomparable'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atul total 9, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
